test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Travelling from the Arctic Circle to the Equator what sequence of biomes would one pass through?

options.text: Tundra, Taiga, Temperate Forests, Tropical Rain Forests
Tropical Rain Forests, Temperate Forests, Taiga, Tundra
Tundra, Temperate Forests, Taiga, Tropical Rain Forests
Taiga, Tundra, Temperate Forests, Tropical Rain Forests

solution:
The correct answer is **Tundra, Taiga, Temperate Forests, Tropical Rain Forests**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tundra** biome is located near the Arctic Circle, characterized by extremely cold temperatures and a lack of trees.
 
• Following the Tundra, one encounters the **Taiga** or Boreal Forest, which has cold winters and coniferous forests.
 
• Next, the **Temperate Forests** biome, which has a moderate climate and a mix of deciduous and coniferous trees.
 
• Finally, near the Equator, one reaches the **Tropical Rain Forests**, known for high biodiversity, warm temperatures, and high rainfall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Biome
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Tundra
 Characterized by **cold, harsh winters**, a **short growing season**, and **permafrost**.
 
 

 Taiga
 Also known as **Boreal Forest**, it features **cold winters** and primarily **coniferous trees**.
 
 

 Temperate Forests
 Have a **moderate climate** and a **mix of deciduous and coniferous trees**.
 
 

 Tropical Rain Forests
 Located near the Equator, these forests have **high biodiversity**, **warm temperatures**, and **high rainfall**.
